name: Create a Palette
summary: Browser palette generator: press the spacebar to create color schemes, lock colors, then export or save them.
description: The palette generator on Coolors: keyboard-driven, with spacebar to generate and Ctrl+E / Ctrl+S to export or save. Palettes export as URL, PDF, image, CSS, ASE, SVG, Tailwind or embed code, with color-blindness simulation, palette contrast check, palette visualizer and zen mode. Free accounts keep up to 10 palettes, 1 project and 1 collection.
contains: palette generator with keyboard shortcuts (spacebar generate, Ctrl+E export, Ctrl+S save)
export as URL, PDF, image, CSS, ASE, SVG, Tailwind and embed code
color-blindness simulation, palette contrast check and palette visualizer
free account limits: 10 saved palettes, 1 project, 1 collection, 5 favorite colors
